profile_text.body:
Mila is a nonprofit artificial intelligence research institute based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, founded in 1993. According to its website, it brings together researchers from Université de Montréal, McGill University, Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal, and describes itself as a community of more than 1,400 researchers specializing in machine learning.

The site describes several programs beyond research. One, offered by Mila and the Public Policy Forum, is designed to give policy and decision makers tools to navigate the opportunities and risks of AI, with a next cohort held in French on September 1-2, 2026, at Mila. Another supports AI startups at any time of the year with resources and tailored support. Mila also describes a venture arm that invests in founders working in deep tech, AI and STEM.

Research summaries on the site include QueStER, a method for generative keyword-based retrieval that trains a rewriting policy with reinforcement learning to produce keyword queries executed by BM25, and a methodology using high spatial resolution commercial satellite imagery to study shrub expansion in Arctic tundra.
